input.quote: 12.3.2.4 Professional Liability: Any subcontractor, including any Permitted Third Party, who provides professional services to such Party for the Clinical Trials, will obtain Professional Liability Insurance in lieu of Clinical Trial Insurance, with a minimum limit of [***] dollars ($[***]) per occurrence.
input.rationale: Section 12.3 has a mutual insurance programme (CGL, umbrella, clinical trials and product liability, certificates on request), but it fails our fallback on two material terms: professional liability (E&O) is imposed only on subcontractors providing professional services, not on SFJ itself, and there is no cyber/privacy cover anywhere in the Agreement (no hits for cyber, privacy or data-breach insurance). The stated limits are redacted, so no existing limit can be treated as satisfying the USD 1M E&O floor. We therefore target the fallback and add the shortest SFJ-level provision carrying E&O of USD 1,000,000 and cyber/privacy of USD 2,000,000, drafted as an SFJ obligation only so it does not add cost or exposure to PB, and leaving the mutual structure and all other limits untouched.

ops.text: Errors and Omissions and Cyber Liability: SFJ will maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance with a minimum limit of one million dollars ($1,000,000) and cyber and privacy liability insurance with a minimum limit of two million dollars ($2,000,000).

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 12.3.2 requires no cyber cover and imposes professional liability only on subcontractors, so we added an SFJ-level E&O and cyber/privacy minimum at our fallback limits (USD 1M / USD 2M).
proposal.summary: Insert SFJ E&O USD 1M and cyber/privacy USD 2M minimums in Section 12.3.2.

mappings.element: Professional errors and omissions coverage is at least USD 1,000,000.
Cyber and privacy coverage is at least USD 2,000,000.
